recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-46973 unless a future work-group decision changes the later subject/focus compartment model.
issue_request: FHIR-46973 was an Applied/Persuasive OO R6 request to restore/add a DeviceAssociation patient search parameter constrained to Patient, correct the subject search parameter to describe and search the broader DeviceAssociation.subject, and add patient to DeviceAssociation patient compartment membership.
initial_application: Jira records application in 11a4adc200, which updated the DeviceAssociation search-parameter bundle and patient compartment row. Follow-up commit 2d0736366a changed the patient search parameter description to the approved 'The patient associated with the device' wording.
additional_context: DeviceAssociation is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source defines subject as DeviceAssociation.subject and patient as DeviceAssociation.subject.where(resolve() is Patient) with target Patient; DeviceAssociation.subject targetProfiles provide the broad subject target list. Later applied FHIR-47604 removed operator and added focus, so current compartments correctly say patient | subject | focus. FHIR-47604 and FHIR-51498 already have combined-branch reconciliation commits.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no current core source edit is needed. The live build renders patient with Target Resources Patient, subject with broad target resources, and DeviceAssociation in the patient compartment by patient or subject or focus.

Later Applied/Persuasive with Modification issue removed operator, added focus, and superseded the older operator compartment wording; already represented on the combined branch.
Device-related compartment audit explains nearby DeviceAssociation compartment evolution; already represented on the combined branch.
